title: 大阪・心斎橋に高級賃貸住宅建設へ　IR開業で赴任の海外企業関係者に照準　関電不動産
extracted_text: カジノを含む統合型リゾート施設（IR）の2030年開業などをにらみ、関電不動産開発が、大阪・心斎橋エリアに新たに長期滞在用の高級賃貸住宅を建設する。ホテルのような高級感がある一方、自炊をはじめとした自由な滞在スタイルが可能。商用目的で数カ月にわたって滞在する海外企業関係者らの利用を見込む。 高級賃貸住宅は「サービスアパートメント」と呼ばれ、関電不動産開発の物件は大阪メトロ心斎橋駅近くに立地する。地上17階建てで低層階に商業施設、その上に1DK～2LDKの計52戸と居住者用のジムやラウンジが整備される。今月着工し、28年10月の完成を予定している。 30年秋ごろには大阪湾の人工島・夢洲（ゆめしま）で、国際会議場などを備えたIRが開業する計画だ。政府は同年の訪日外国人客6千万人の目標を掲げており、国際会議などの誘致を支援する。 こうした中、関電不動産開発が見据えるターゲット層は、IR開業などに合わせて大阪に赴任するようなグローバル企業関係者らだ。 ホテルでの滞在中は外食が続く上、クリーニングなどの費用もかさむ。関電不動産開発のサービスアパートメントでは、清掃やリネン交換サービスが提供される一方、家電・家具を完備。自炊や洗濯ができ、ホテルより費用を抑えられる利点がある。 同社の心斎橋の物件は、JR大阪駅に近い繁華街・北新地での物件に続き2件目。新物件の賃貸費用は未定だが、北新地では1カ月当たり40万～70万円程度となっている。 関電不動産開発によると、大阪市内のサービスアパートメントの供給戸数は現在400戸ほどにとどまるが、IR開業などに伴う需要は1800人程度に膨らむとみる。同社関係者は「大阪では今後も需要が伸びるとみている。可能な限り事業を拡大したい」と話した。（黒川信雄）
translated_text: With an integrated resort (IR) facility including a casino slated to open around 2030, Kansai Electric Real Estate Development will build a new high-end rental property for long-term stays in the Osaka Shinsaibashi area. It offers a premium feel similar to a hotel, while allowing a flexible lifestyle including self-catering. The property is expected to be used by overseas corporate personnel staying for several months on business. The high-end rental housing, called a "service apartment," will be located near Osaka Metro Shinsaibashi Station. The building will be 17 stories tall, with commercial facilities on the lower floors and 52 units ranging from 1DK to 2LDK above, along with a gym and lounge for residents. Construction begins this month, with completion scheduled for October 2028. Around autumn 2030, an IR facility equipped with an international conference hall is planned to open on the artificial island of Yumeshima in Osaka Bay. The government has set a target of 6 million foreign visitors to Japan that year and is supporting efforts to attract international conferences. Against this backdrop, Kansai Electric Real Estate Development's target demographic consists of global corporate personnel who will be stationed in Osaka in connection with the IR opening. Staying at hotels entails continuous dining out and additional cleaning expenses. In Kansai Electric's service apartments, cleaning and linen exchange services are provided, along with fully equipped appliances and furniture, allowing for self-catering and laundry, which helps reduce costs compared to hotels. The Shinsaibashi property is the company's second location, following a property in Kita新地, a commercial district near JR Osaka Station. Rental costs for the new property have not been decided, but in Kita新地, they range from approximately 400,000 to 700,000 yen per month. According to Kansai Electric Real Estate Development, service apartment supply in Osaka currently amounts to only about 400 units, but demand related to the IR opening is expected to grow to around 1,800 people. A company representative said, "We expect demand to continue growing in Osaka. We want to expand our business as much as possible."
title_en: Kansai Electric Real Estate to Build High-End Rental Housing in Osaka Shinsaibashi for Overseas IR Personnel
